BackendKind.description:
Known backend kinds.

The `Virtual`/`Netcam`/`File` kinds map to synthetic backends created via
helpers in `styx::capture_api`.

capture_avg_fps.description: Capture stage throughput for this format (context).

controls.description: Capture controls to apply during benchmark runs (e.g., exposure).

modes.description:
Optional explicit mode list to benchmark (skips device probing on the server).

When present, the server will benchmark exactly these mode ids and render each group using
the provided `format` (FOURCC) string.

restore_existing.description: Stop conflicting streams while benchmarking, then restore them.

update_id.description: Optional update id to cancel. When omitted, the currently active update is canceled.

target_fps.description:
Target FPS request used by the engine for pacing/metrics and libcamera frame timing.

When `interval` is not explicitly set, `target_fps` is translated into a frame interval for
all backends, including libcamera. The live OV9782 path can sustain higher rates than the
default 33.3 ms cadence, and treating `target_fps` as a no-op leaves the sensor parked at
~30 fps even when the requested stream target is higher.

average_time_ms.description: Throughput-derived cadence for this stage (`1000 / fps`).

last_time_ms.description: Last observed cadence for this stage. Kept aligned with `average_time_ms`.

work_average_time_ms.description: Actual stage work time over the rolling window.

work_last_time_ms.description: Actual work time for the last completed sample.

average_time_ms.description: Average inter-frame time at this stage (derived from throughput).

last_time_ms.description: Last observed inter-frame time at this stage (may be 0 if unknown).

work_average_time_ms.description: Average processing time spent inside this stage (work time), independent of downstream waits.

work_last_time_ms.description: Last processing time spent inside this stage (work time), independent of downstream waits.

ControlMeta.description:
Simplified control metadata.

# Example
```rust
use styx_core::prelude::{Access, ControlId, ControlKind, ControlMeta, ControlMetadata, ControlValue};

let meta = ControlMeta {
    id: ControlId(1),
    name: "gain".into(),
    kind: ControlKind::Uint,
    access: Access::ReadWrite,
    min: ControlValue::Uint(0),
    max: ControlValue::Uint(255),
    default: ControlValue::Uint(16),
    step: Some(ControlValue::Uint(1)),
    menu: None,
    metadata: ControlMetadata::default(),
};
assert!(meta.validate(&ControlValue::Uint(32)));
```

menu.description: Optional enumerated menu entries (for menu controls).

oneOf.description: Optional step size for ranged controls.

requires_tdn_output.description: Control requires a dedicated TDN output stream to be enabled.

engine_cpu_avg.description: Average `helios-engine` CPU usage for this run (sysinfo `%`, can exceed 100 on multi-core).

system_cpu_avg.description: Average total CPU usage for this run (sysinfo `%`).

fps_limit.description: Optional soft limit for decode FPS; frames above this are dropped before decode/graph.

mirror_horizontal.description: Optional horizontal mirror applied after decode.

rotation_degrees.description: Optional rotation applied after decode (0/90/180/270 degrees).

DeviceIdentity.description:
Physical device identity derived from fingerprints/props.

`display` is a human-friendly string, while `keys` contains fingerprints
that help merge identical devices across backends.

FanConfig.description: Declarative configuration for a PWM fan curve.

curve.description: Sorted temperature breakpoints and corresponding duty cycles.

invert_pwm.description: Whether PWM polarity should be inverted (100% duty = 0% fan speed).

manual_percent.description: Optional manual override; when set, the controller drives the fan at this percentage.

max_percent.description: Maximum duty cycle expressed as a percentage (0-100).

min_percent.description: Minimum duty cycle expressed as a percentage (0-100).

poll_interval_ms.description: Poll interval for recomputing the fan target, in milliseconds.

pwm_path.description: Sysfs path to the pwmN file exposed by the fan driver (usually under /sys/class/hwmon).

tacho_path.description: Optional sysfs path that reports tachometer readings (fan*_input) in RPM.

gravity_reference_axis.description: Align the current acceleration (gravity) direction to a chassis axis (e.g. "+y", "-z").

reset_pose.description: Reset integrated world-frame velocity/position used for short-window dead reckoning.

snap_gravity.description: Convenience flag: align gravity to the nearest axis.

JsonWire.description:
A serde JSON value that remains JSON in HTTP/OpenAPI payloads, but is encoded as JSON bytes when
serialized over binary IPC transports.

The archived representation is a real tree, not a JSON blob string or serde-bytes wrapper.

LedConfig.description: Declarative configuration for a single addressable LED chain.

snapPitchToGround.description: Snap field-space pitch to level (0 deg).

snapRollToGround.description: Snap field-space roll to level (0 deg).

snapZToGround.description:
Snap the "height" axis to the ground plane when reporting field-space poses.

Note: in the viewer/three.js frame, +Y is up. This option name uses "Z" to match
common robotics conventions (e.g. WPILib) where Z is up.

format.description: Media format associated with the mode.

id.description: Identifier (format + optional interval) for this mode.

format.description: Pixel format and resolution for this mode.

oneOf.description: Optional interval associated with this mode (if the mode is interval-specific).

address.description: IPv4 address used when static mode is active

subscriptions_enabled.description: When disabled, HeliOS will avoid subscribing to NetworkTables topics (used by explorer + peer telemetry).

captured_at_ms.description: Unix timestamp (ms) when the flamegraph was captured.

groups.description: Optional aggregated node-group metrics (e.g. embedded graphs).

average_branch_instructions.description: Average branch instructions per node call (rolling window).

average_branch_misses.description: Average branch misses per node call (rolling window).

average_cache_misses.description: Average cache misses per node call (rolling window).

children.description: Nested metrics for grouped nodes, keyed by node/group id.

node_index.description: Node index within the planned graph (`NodeRef.0`).

node_label.description: Optional node label from the planned graph.

node_type.description: Node type identifier (Daedalus node id), e.g. `cv:contour:contours`.

average_branch_instructions.description: Average branch instructions per graph run (rolling window).

average_branch_misses.description: Average branch misses per graph run (rolling window).

average_cache_misses.description: Average cache misses per graph run (rolling window).

encoder_input_decoder.description: For encoder benchmarks we pick a single decoder (if available) to provide RG24.

controls.description: Capture controls to apply during benchmark runs (e.g., exposure).

mode_ids.description: Benchmark only these mode IDs (defaults to all modes for the backend).

restore_existing.description: Stop conflicting streams while benchmarking, then restore them.

sample_frames.description:
Number of frames to wait per sampling window (per mode + per codec).

If unset, `sample_ms` determines the sampling window.

sample_timeout_ms.description:
Max time to wait per sampling window (per mode + per codec), in milliseconds.

If unset, `sample_ms` determines the sampling window.

active_pipeline_id.description: Active pipeline ID when `pipelines` is set.

active_pipeline_output.description: Selected host output port for the active pipeline when `pipelines` is set.

oneOf.description: Optional saved calibration intrinsics/distortion coefficients for this camera.

internal.description:
Internal streams are created by the system for tasks like benchmarking and should not
appear in user-facing stream lists / registration UX.

pipeline_enabled.description: When set to `false`, force the stream to run without any pipeline graph (raw frames).

pipeline_host_inputs.description:
Persisted host-bridge input values applied to the active pipeline graph at startup/rebuild.

Used for stream-level controls like ROI crop, crosshair, and ordering mode.

oneOf.description: Optional layout for multiplex rendering (rows/columns + slot assignments).

pipeline_wires.description: Optional wiring between pipeline outputs and downstream pipeline inputs.

pipelines.description: Optional additional pipeline graphs to run in multiplex/debug view.

oneOf.description: Optional rig pose (translation + rotation) for this camera.

recording_mode.description: Recording mode contract for capture-last buffers and future recording policies.

pipeline_output.description: Optional host-bridge output port to use as the pipeline's frame output.

oneOf.description: Optional per-stream patch applied on top of the pipeline graph.

StreamPipelineEndpoint.description:
Endpoint in the multiplex pipeline wiring graph.

This identifies a specific pipeline *instance* (pipeline ID + optional layout `output_key`)
and a port name on that instance.

output_key.description:
Optional instance discriminator when a pipeline appears multiple times with different
layout `output_key` values.

port.description:
Port name on the pipeline instance. For pipeline frame input, this is typically `frame`.
For pipeline outputs, this can be omitted to use the instance's selected output port.

output_key.description: Optional host-bridge output port override for this slot.

StreamPipelineWire.description: Wire a port from one pipeline instance into an input port on another pipeline instance.
